text:
mike: FYI I'm seeing steady memory growth on the canary for streaming + tool loops. ~+1.1GB over ~90m. Looks like KV residency keeps climbing instead of plateauing.

sara: can you paste the repro or logs? which model/quant/profile?

mike: repro is in test-run:stream_toolloop_longcontext (10 concurrent sessions, avg turn 800 tokens). Model rwd-13b-qat, int8-ish. Quick log: 
```
[2026-03-17T11:12:03Z] kv: total_pages=13280 resident=12140 pinned=800 free=340
[2026-03-17T12:42:03Z] kv: total_pages=13280 resident=13150 pinned=860 free=270
```
looks like resident rises even with eviction enabled.

alex: hmm. batching heuristics changed around the same time as the kernel-selection tweak two weeks ago. Could be the runtime picking a kernel that disables some page-coalescing path. Did you try forcing old kernel?

mike: not yet. I can spin the canary with KERNEL_FORCE=old-kernel and compare.

jess: I ran a short profile on one session. The hotspot is the pager thread doing page_walk + reclaim loops, but reclaim returns few pages, then reclaims again (high churn). Flame excerpt: 
```
pager_loop 60%
  try_reclaim 35%
    scan_pages 20%
    meta_lock 10%
alloc 10%
serialize_kv 5%
```
Suggests fragmentation + metadata contention.

sara: note that we enabled aggressive prefix caching last month for latency — that increases residency since we keep KV slices longer. But it should still evict when free < threshold. Mike, can you paste the eviction config from the canary?

mike: eviction config: `evict.min_free_percent=2`, `evict.target_free_percent=8`, `evict.scan_batch=64`, `kv.coalesce=false` (we flipped coalesce for a quant perf change).

alex: there we go — `kv.coalesce=false` + long contexts likely cause many small sparse pages to live and the recycler fails to find contiguous runs to free, so resident climbs. The kernel selection change also reduced the recompact window, so metadata compaction is slower.

jess: quick experiment: I re-enabled coalesce on a dev stack and ran a 2h toolloop session -> resident plateaued after ~30m. Patch looks promising.

mike: can you share the command/patch?

jess: patch: set `kv.coalesce=true` and increase `evict.scan_batch` to 256. Also bumped `recompact.interval_ms` from 60000 to 15000. Ran: `./run_canary --profile -c canary-coalesce.json` output: resident stabilized at ~7.8GB.

perf-bot: perf-regression-check: change request #4821 created to revert coalesce disable and schedule a canary rollout. Link: https://git.internal/r/4821

sara: next steps: (1) mike to run canary with coalesce=true + larger scan_batch for 24h, (2) alex to audit kernel-selection change for any flags that lower compaction priority, (3) jess to add a regression unit test that runs long toolloops with coalesce toggled.

mike: queued canary run now. I'll post results in ~24h. Thanks. :thumbsup:

alex: also add a quick metric: "kv.fragmentation_ratio" (freeable_pages / total_pages) to the console so we can alert earlier.

jess: noted. I'll add a dashboard card and a simple alert if fragmentation_ratio > 0.15 for >15m.

mike: awesome. If this stabilizes, we should avoid kernel rollback and just tune defaults back.

sara: good plan. tagging @oncall for awareness.
